scripts.build:e2e: tsc -b && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && MINDVERSE_BUILD_DIR=../.e2e-web VITE_E2E_DIAGNOSTICS=1 vite build && node scripts/verify-build-boundaries.mjs ../.e2e-web
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_RENDERER=babylon npm run build:e2e && VITE_RENDERER=babylon playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:functional: VITE_RENDERER=babylon npm run build:e2e && VITE_RENDERER=babylon playwright test --project=swiftshader-functional
scripts.test:e2e:performance: VITE_RENDERER=babylon npm run build:e2e && VITE_RENDERER=babylon playwright test --project=metal-performance
scripts.capture:parity-reference: VITE_RENDERER=three npm run build:e2e && MINDVERSE_PARITY_OUT=testdata/render-baselines/three-parity-v1.json playwright test --project=visual-parity
scripts.capture:parity-candidate: VITE_RENDERER=babylon npm run build:e2e && MINDVERSE_PARITY_OUT=testdata/render-baselines/babylon-parity-candidate.json playwright test --project=visual-parity
scripts.capture:mode-bar: VITE_RENDERER=babylon npm run build:e2e && MINDVERSE_MODE_OUT=testdata/render-baselines/babylon-mode-bar.json playwright test --project=visual-parity --grep 'mode bar button'
scripts.verify:visual-parity: npm run capture:parity-candidate && npm run compare:visual-parity
scripts.verify:stellar-baseline: MINDVERSE_REFERENCE_DEVICE=1 MINDVERSE_BASELINE_OUT=testdata/render-baselines/babylon-stellar-candidate.json npm run test:e2e:performance && npm run compare:stellar-baselines
